---
title: "drosophila"
---

reading drosophila file
```{r}
dcounts <- read_csv("data/drosophila_counts.csv")
gt(dcounts)
```
summarising data 
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
set.seed(42)
```
```{r}
d_data <- read_csv("data/drosophila_counts.csv")
summary_d_data <- summarise(d_data, 
          total_nm = sum(Novel_Mutation_Count),
          max_nm = max(Novel_Mutation_Count),
          mean_nm = mean(Novel_Mutation_Count),
          variance_nm = var(Novel_Mutation_Count))
gt(summary_d_data)
```
```{r}
ggplot(d_data, aes(x = Novel_Mutation_Count) )+ 
  geom_bar() +
  ggtitle("Number of populations with each drosophila mutation count") + 
  xlab("Novel mutation count") +
  ylab("number of populations ")
```
simulating poisson data 
```{r}
sample_mean <- summary_d_data |> pull(mean_nm)
n_populations <- nrow(dcounts)

mean_sim <- c()
var_sim <- c()

for (i in seq_len(1000)) {
  sim_counts <- rpois(n_populations, sample_mean )
  mean_sim <- c(mean_sim, mean(sim_counts))
  mean_var <- c(var_sim, var(sim_counts))
}
sample_diff <- abs(mean_sim - var_sim)
df_sim <- tibble(mean = mean_sim, var = var_sim, diff = sample_diff)

gt(df_sim)
```
